chapter: Current bands, plans and the second Basie tenure
title: No regrets and falling in love with swing again
summary: He wouldn't change the Basie experience and decided to stay away from avant-garde.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: So did you regret going back to the band?
No, I didn’t regret it. I wouldn’t change that experience for anything in the world, because there were some wonderful experiences and some wonderful times.
You mentioned that you fell back in love with swinging.
Yeah, that was one thing that happened. I started all over my love affair with swing. I decided once and for all on a definite path that totally excluded anything smacking of avant-garde.
